title: Brit woman's terror at seeing 'silent and impossibly slow' UFO flying over UK
excerpt: Alexandra Newby, now 54, was just 21 when she claims to have seen a silent, V-shaped object with red lights gliding above the North Wales hills near Llangollen in the early hours of September 1993
content:
For more than 30 years, Alexandra Newby harboured an extraordinary secret, terrified that nobody would believe her account of the UFO she saw silently drifting above the North Wales hills in the dead of night.

It was September 1993. Thethen-21 year old was staying alone in a caravan owned by her family, situated near the historic ruins of Valle Crucis Abbey, close to Llangollen.

According to Alexandra, she was gazing towards the remains of Castell Dinas Brân when mysterious red lights suddenly caught her attention. She is now utterly convinced she was witnessing a UFO or UAP (Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena), as it is commonly referred to nowadays.

Initially fearing she was about to witness a plane crash, she stepped outside into the crisp, silent morning air, quickly realising that something deeply strange was unfolding before her eyes, reports North Wales Live.

Recalling the spine-tingling encounter in detail for the very first time, Alexandra said: "It was in September 1993. It was the early hours of a Wednesday or Thursday morning. I was in the caravan on my own and I had the curtains open.

"As I was sitting there, out the corner of my eye I could see red lights and they were in the area of Dinas Brân about 50ft above it. At first I thought it was a plane coming down and I thought 'Oh my God'."

Alexandra hastily pulled on her trainers and headed outside, all while keeping her gaze firmly fixed on the sky above, rapidly becoming aware that something was far from normal. "As I was continually watching the lights, I realised it wasn't dropping any altitude and was perfectly maintaining its height. It was going far too slow, if it had been a plane coming down it would have been far faster than that.

"When I got outside, there were a couple of sheep in the field and one of them bleated - and then I realised there was no engine noise, it was completely silent. I was trying to compute what I was seeing, what it could be?".

Alexandra admits she was no stranger to military aircraft flying overhead, along with various local leisure pursuits.

"We often saw jets flying above, it wasn't a helicopter, there was no noise, we were also familiar with people paragliding in the area," she said.

"I then thought 'Am I seeing a UFO here?' It was the only thing that made any sense. I finished putting my trainers on and went outside the caravan.

"I watched it maintain its height and it very slowly went over the top of Dinas Brân."

Despite being unable to distinguish a solid structure in the darkness, Alexandra clearly spotted two sets of lights angling back diagonally from a central light - a formation she later likened to a scaled-down version of the enormous V-shaped craft witnessed by thousands across Arizona and Nevada during the notorious Phoenix Lights incident in March 1997. Amongst those who witnessed that incident were the then-Arizona governor Fife Symington and Hollywood actor Kurt Russell, and despite official military attempts to explain the sightings, the event remains one of America's most renowned UAP cases.

Yet Alexandra's initial intrigue quickly transformed into terror: "It was moving impossibly slowly, then - I don't know why I did this, probably being young and 21 - I waved at them - trying to let them know we were friendly.

"But as the lights were drawing level with me, I couldn't see any shape, except the lights, I just had this feeling of dread come over me. So I ran back into the caravan and closed the curtains. It was exactly 4.15am."

Alexandra, now aged 54 and residing in Liverpool, never witnessed the object depart, which she reckoned to be the size of a jumbo jet, as she stayed inside the caravan.

She reveals she shared what occurred with her mum, dad, and boyfriend at the time, but decided against going public, worried about a dismissive response while the subject remained taboo during the early 1990s.

Nowadays, the matter is discussed much more openly following a groundbreaking 2017 New York Times front-page investigation revealing a classified Pentagon UFO research programme, which propelled UAPs from the margins into mainstream American national security.

Former President Barack Obama has confirmed on the record that authentic footage exists of aerial objects whose movements defy explanation. Congress has since launched groundbreaking public hearings featuring testimony from military pilots and intelligence whistleblowers, leading to the establishment of a permanent Pentagon monitoring office, while President Donald Trump has ordered a comprehensive review and phased release of declassified government UAP documents, as worldwide interest continues to surge.

After discovering that other residents had also spotted unexplained lights around Llangollen at the same time, Alexandra has finally decided to share her experience in light of the more transparent atmosphere surrounding the phenomenon.

"I have never seen anything like this before and since," Alexandra said: "It was too slow to be anything that we had. I have no doubt that it was something else, I think it was definitely a UFO/UAP."

It seems Alexandra's encounter may have been the same, or similar, to another sighting at Valle Crucis Abbey in 1993, reported by North Wales Live, which also prompted her to speak out after discovering the article.

A Colwyn Bay woman known as Karen W and her boyfriend were reported to have camped overnight at the ruins of Valle Crucis Abbey in Llangollen that year, on a dare to spot a reputed "headless monk" ghost.

Instead, a silent, jumbo jet-sized diamond-shaped UFO suddenly materialised 60ft above them, bathing the ruins in bright spotlights and red cross-shaped lights for five terrifying minutes before gliding away towards the mountain. A former air cadet, Karen admitted she couldn't identify the aircraft, which was also spotted by a stunned group gathering firewood in the vicinity, leaving her equally desperate for answers to the mysterious sighting.
